replies.content: Thanks! I don’t think the exact BC warm-up setup is the key part — roughly speaking, higher-scoring players are more valuable demonstrations. For checkpoint selection, I built a small local leaderboard for evaluation and occasionally submit checkpoints to the real Kaggle ladder to validate it. The hard part is that Kaggle feedback is quite slow, so deciding which agent to trust for the final submission still takes some careful judgment.
